notes: Thomas Hospitality Group is a Michigan-based hospitality business broker specializing in restaurants, bars, and hospitality properties. The site uses WordPress with custom post type 'thg_business'. Successfully extracted 36 listings with title, status (FOR SALE/OFF MARKET), description, and details table containing price, rent, MLCC license type, property type, and parking. The details_table field contains combined text from the table that can be parsed for individual fields like price, rent, property type, etc. Note: URL and image attribute extraction may need post-processing to extract href/src attributes.
